messages:
ellie: Planning a config-only rollout for eu-west: lower global batch_size from 128 -> 96, tighten per-tenant concurrency soft-limit 40 -> 32, and increase idle request timeout 9s -> 13s. No model file change. Deploy-bot scheduled 2024-05-21T11:37:00Z. Canary plan: 1% -> 12% over 10m, then 40% after hold. Will leave a 20m post-ramp hold.

sam: Ack. Ops: Ken + Maya oncall. Note: small batch size reduction should lower memory pressure but may nudge p95 slightly for long sequences. Watch decoder-latency and gpu-mem-usage.

anita: Added rollback automation: pin routing back to rewrite-stable if p95 > 1400ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 2m. Runbook link: /runbooks/config-rollbacks/batch-concurrency-fallback.md. Also added temporary alert on tenant_concurrency_violations.

ellie: Canary config snippet for record:
```
route: rewrite-eu-west
canary: {start_pct:1, target_pct:12, step_min:5}
params: {global_batch_size:96, per_tenant_soft_limit:32, idle_timeout_ms:13000}
fallback: rewrite-stable
rollback_thresholds: {p95_ms:1400, error_rate_pct:0.5}
```
(putting in release notes)

deploy-bot: Deploy started: job_id=deploy-1742002020. Canary=1% duration=10m. Dash: https://console.redwood/deploys/1742002020

ken: Canary 6m in: p95=430ms, error_rate=0.02%, gpu_mem_pressure stable. No 5xx. Advancing to 4% per plan.

maya: Observability: cache-warm and kvcache-hit rate steady. A small tenant (tenant-210) shows retry_count increase, paging their owner to confirm expected behavior.

anita: Reminder: temporary alerting mutes for low-volume tenants applied to avoid false positives. Also lowered sensitivity on noisy decoder OOM alerts for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Moving to staged ramp to 40% over 15m. Applying config to shard groups incrementally.

sam: After ramp check: p95=475ms, error_rate=0.03%, tenant_concurrency_violations=0.01%. No regressions. Proceeding with post-ramp 20m hold.

ellie: Release-note draft: "Config-only: adjusted batching and per-tenant concurrency in eu-west for rewrite models to reduce memory pressure; increased idle timeout. Automated fallback to rewrite-stable on thresholds. No model binary changes." Will notify release channel after hold.

ken: Holding for post-ramp window. If anything suspicious shows up I will post metrics and consider rollback.

deploy-bot: Post-ramp hold complete: 20m passed, health checks green. Config rollout marked successful. job_id=deploy-1742002020.

ellie: Thanks team. Closing thread in 1h if no late regressions. :tada:
